source.text: India: Matri Bhumi is a 1959 Italian documentary film-fiction hybrid film directed by Roberto Rossellini. The film combines the Neorealist style Rossellini helped develop in his native Italy with poetic voice-over narration. One of the writers for the screenplay was Iranian diplomat Fereydoun Hoveyda. It was entered into the 1st Moscow International Film Festival.
source.title: India: Matri Bhumi

source.text: Roberto Gastone Zeffiro Rossellini( 8 May 1906 – 3 June 1977) was an Italian film director, screenwriter, and producer. Rossellini was one of the directors of the Italian neorealist cinema, contributing to the movement with films such as" Rome, Open City"( 1945)," Paisan"( 1946)," Germany, Year Zero"( 1948), and" General Della Rovere"( 1959).
source.title: Roberto Rossellini
